selection.criteria: Brex's official developer overview links the ten provider OpenAPI product references; its preserved source surface has exactly the immutable 108-operation survey count.

connectors.evidence_source: metadata docs_url; provider-published Brex per-product OpenAPI bundles linked by the OpenAPI directory
connectors.counting_note: Brex's provider-published OpenAPI directory links ten product bundles: transactions, expenses, team, payments, webhooks, budgets, accounting, fields, onboarding, and travel. Counted every method/path across these non-overlapping artifacts: 59 GET reads, 34 POST, 10 PUT, and five DELETE writes. No POST action is a semantic query; each creates, updates, lifecycle-transitions, sends, or reports server-side state.
connectors.selection_reason: official Brex developer overview exact-surface evidence fallback after the legacy /openapi/ directory returned 404; overview links the ten provider OpenAPI product references
